text:
maya_cs: Quick check-in on HALYARD private onboarding — week1 health and a couple of potential renewal flags.

maya_cs: Summary: network routing + KMS rotation ask from customer, they want 90-day key rotation window and 13-month audit log retention. Also asked if we can whitelist a pair of CIDRs for a legacy NAT.

sam_sre: Seen the CIDRs, can we confirm they need inbound on 10.8.32.0/22 or just egress? I think it's egress only for model traffic.

maya_cs: They said inbound for syslogs collector (customer-managed). I'll ping their infra to confirm exact ports. @sam_sre can you validate firewall rule implications for our shared peering setup? :eyes:

sam_sre: quick note: for peering we only allow specific routes; adding inbound means we need an explicit route + SG tweak. Minimal change is:

```
route add 10.8.32.0/22 via peering-eni
security-group: allow tcp 514 from 10.8.32.0/22
```

sam_sre: This will increase our monitoring surface — tagging for audit required.

oliver_infra: IAM side — customer asked for cross-account role to push logs. We should use a scoped role with GetObject/PutObject to their S3 bucket and assume-role limited to the logging agent principal. Example policy:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],
    "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::halyard-logs/*",
    "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalArn":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/halyard-logs-agent"}}
  }]
}
```

oliver_infra: We'll provision the role template in the runbook and request their account id.

danielle_cs: Renewal note: customer mentioned retention + rotation in contract review call. If we accept 13-month logs and 90-day rotation as a free config it bumps storage & ops. We should capture as a commercial deviation and surface to AMs.

maya_cs: Agreed — logging retention is a clear cost delta. I'll open a ticket to ops and CC revenue team.

kms-checker-bot: KMS status for halyard-cmk: Key rotation enabled=false, last-rotated=2024-10-02, policy: custom-rotation-policy-1

sam_sre: KMS bot shows rotation off — we need to either enable automatic rotation or provide docs for customer-managed rotation. Enabling rotation affects existing CMK aliases; needs change freeze window.

maya_cs: Customer wants 90-day rotation. Ops question: do we have an automated rotation workflow that supports 90-day for customer CMKs? @oliver_infra

oliver_infra: Our internal rotation service supports 30/60/365 by default; 90 is uncommon but doable. Work is ~3 dev-days and needs rollout validation. Alternative: advise customer to manage rotation in their account and we'll accept rotated keys via alias swap.

danielle_cs: Commercially, offering to build 90-day rotation as part of onboarding is a potential one-time engineering cost; recommend quoting it to customer and offering a self-managed option in meantime.

maya_cs: Action items:
- @sam_sre: give firewall + peering change steps and risk note (ETA EOD)
- @oliver_infra: create IAM role template + runbook snippet (ETA 48h)
- @danielle_cs: open commercial deviation with pricing suggestion (ETA tomorrow)
- @maya_cs: confirm CIDR/ports with customer's infra and update ticket

maya_cs: Also capture feedback: they said onboarding docs were good but wanted clearer examples for cross-account logging and an explicit KMS rotation matrix. I'll add those to docs backlog.

sam_sre: small test plan request: can we ask customer to send a sample syslog payload to our collector test endpoint once the peering change is staged? That verifies routes + SG.

maya_cs: I'll schedule the test for Wednesday with their DevOps. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

kms-checker-bot: Reminder scheduled: rotate-check job queued for 1719860000

maya_cs: Closing loop — will follow up with tickets and link them here. If anything blocks, ping me in #customer-success or DM.
